title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Ethan Cole
description: Adds priority-aware burst utilization reporting and related telemetry plumbing for Dedicated fleets. Motivation: operators asked for clearer visibility into how priority-weighted traffic consumes burst tokens and how that maps to autoscaler behavior (canary and SLA tiers). This PR instruments a new set of metrics (priority_burst_used, priority_burst_capacity, priority_burst_drain_rate) with tags for fleet_id, priority_tier, and model_family, exposes them to the metrics backend, and wires the console to render a stacked burst utilization chart. Also adds an opt-in config to the autoscaler that enables per-priority accounting used by the reporting pipeline; the algorithm is a reporting-only change (no runtime scheduling changes) to avoid rollout risk. Includes tests, migration script for preexisting Prometheus label backfills, docs, and a short migration guide for Dedicated operators.
commit_summary: 1) Add PriorityScaler component with per-priority accounting and reporting hooks; 2) Emit BurstMetrics from telemetry service and tag by priority_tier and fleet_id; 3) Console: new BurstUtilChart and API route for per-priority series; 4) CI updates and migration SQL; 5) Docs and release notes.
review_comments: Priya Raman: Nice breakdown — please add a unit test covering zero-capacity fleets and one for label cardinality to prevent high-metric-cardinality regressions.
Ethan Cole: Added tests for zero-capacity and a sampling guard to limit label cardinality; updated telemetry docs with sampling rationale.
Marta Lopez: Can we include an example of how this affects billing dashboards? Suggest adding an annotation in the console that maps burst usage to token cost estimates.

Ethan Cole: Added a tooltip to the chart showing estimated token-cost per priority bucket and linked the calculation to the cost model in services/costing (non-functional change to maintain separation).
Jules Kim: CI flaked on linux-integration once — reran and green. Approving after minor nits fixed in follow-up commit.
Release manager (internal note): Marking as non-breaking. Ensure migration SQL runs during maintenance window for large fleets.
release_notes: Enhanced dedicated autoscaler reporting: priority-aware burst utilization metrics, console visualization (Burst Utilization chart), migration SQL for metrics labeling, and an opt-in per-priority accounting config. This improves visibility for multi-tenant fleets and helps correlate burst consumption to cost and SLA tiers.
